model: softflowd NetFlow / IPFIX probe on Alpine Linux 3.20

capture.image: alpine:3.20 (+ apk: softflowd 1.1.0-r0, pmacct 1.7.8-r1, tcpdump 4.99.4-r1, curl, busybox-extras)
capture.command: exporter 192.168.128.5: tcpdump -i eth0 -U -w traffic.pcap 'host 192.168.128.7 and (tcp port 80 or udp port 5514)' while running 3x curl http://192.168.128.7/blob.bin (16 KiB, busybox httpd), 1x curl http://192.168.128.7/index.html and 4x echo 'openmap flow lab datagram N' | nc -u -w1 192.168.128.7 5514; then softflowd -d -r traffic.pcap -v 5 -n 192.168.128.6:2055, -v 9 -n 192.168.128.6:2056, -v 10 -n 192.168.128.6:2057. Receiver 192.168.128.6: tcpdump -i eth0 -U -w netflow-v5.pcap 'udp dst port 2055' (and 2056 -> netflow-v9.pcap, 2057 -> ipfix.pcap).

files.name: netflow-v5.pcap
files.description: NetFlow v5 export datagram(s) as received on the wire (Ethernet / IPv4 / UDP), 12 flow records

files.name: netflow-v9.pcap
files.description: NetFlow v9 export datagram(s) with template and data flowsets, 12 records

files.name: ipfix.pcap
files.description: IPFIX (version 10) export datagram(s) with template and data sets, 12 records

files.name: traffic.pcap
files.description: the traffic softflowd accounted (ground truth): 4 HTTP connections (60 packets, 53455 IP bytes) and 4 UDP datagrams (224 IP bytes)

files.name: softflowd-stdout.log
files.description: softflowd's own statistics for each export run

notes: softflowd 1.1.0 receives but never dispatches live packets with libpcap 1.10 (Alpine 3.20 and Debian 12 alike: 'Packets received by libpcap: 269, Packets processed: 0'), so it exported from the live-recorded traffic capture with its documented -r mode; the export datagrams are softflowd's real output and the capture is the real traffic.
